name: M365Gov_DataHealth

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Each source product owns its telemetry; Microsoft Sentinel owns workspace ingestion health

freshness.expected: Per-table thresholds are embedded in the expected-source catalog.

limitations: UnavailableOrSilent combines absence, lack of permission, connector disablement, and no events.
A quiet but correctly configured source can be reported as silent.
Freshness does not prove semantic completeness or licensing coverage.

missingSourceBehavior.description: Every expected source remains visible and is labeled UnavailableOrSilent when no observation is available.
